verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an accounting SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export feature, no open-format downloads, and no account-exit path. The migration evidence covers importing into Wave from other software, not exporting out. The live GraphQL endpoint is at most a developer building block with no documented export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
